messages.text:
"Create a cozy 3D plant shop simulator called
\"The Little Greenhouse.\"

The game takes place inside a beautiful,
whimsical plant shop with an attached greenhouse.

The player controls a customizable character
who can freely walk around the entire shop
in third-person perspective.

Create a charming, hand-painted animated-film
aesthetic with soft lighting, rounded shapes,
lush greenery, warm sunlight, gentle shadows,
and detailed environmental animations.

The shop should feel alive.

Plants should sway gently, leaves should move
in the breeze, sunlight should shift throughout
the day, and dust particles should float
through sunbeams.

The player should be able to interact with
individual plants, water them, repot them,
fertilize them, prune them, and monitor
their growth.

Customers should enter the shop, browse
the plants, admire them, and purchase plants.

The primary gameplay loop is growing,
caring for, displaying, and selling plants.

Make the experience relaxing, immersive,
beautiful, and rewarding.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
